webhook.description:
A source component that listens for incoming HTTP requests and accepts 
uploaded documents or data from external systems or processes. It enables 
seamless integration for document ingestion, allowing external systems to 
trigger the component and send files for further processing. Configurable 
with endpoint and authentication settings, it ensures secure and reliable 
document transfer for pipeline processing. Ideal for receiving documents, 
images, or other files from external platforms via HTTP-based communication.
webhook.title: Webhook

agent_rocketride.description:
Wave-planning agent built natively on the RocketRide architecture.
Plans each step as a wave of parallel tool calls, uses keyed memory to stay token-efficient,
and requests tool schemas on demand instead of loading them all upfront.
Can be invoked as a tool (`<nodeId>.run_agent`) for hierarchical agent orchestration.

llm.description: LLM used by the agent for planning and synthesis

memory.description: Keyed memory for the agent (via control-plane invoke)

tool.description: Tools available to the agent (via control-plane invoke)

agent_description.description: What does this agent do? Describe its purpose and capabilities, this helps parent agents select and invoke it correctly.
agent_description.title: Agent description

instructions.description: Additional instructions to guide the agent's planning and responses.
instructions.title: Instructions

max_waves.description: Maximum number of planning iterations before the synthesis fallback fires.
max_waves.title: Max Waves

require_tool_call.description: Require the agent to invoke at least one tool before answering. When on, a run that answers without calling any tool fails with a guard error. Use for determinism-critical pipelines where an ungrounded or narrated answer must never be delivered. Off by default.
require_tool_call.title: Require tool call

agent_rocketride.title: RocketRide Wave

llm_anthropic.description:
A component that integrates with Anthropic's Claude models for natural 
language understanding and generation. It enables tasks such as 
summarization, question answering, content generation, and conversational 
AI. Configurable with model selection and prompt settings, the component 
provides access to Claude's advanced language capabilities with a strong focus 
on safety, alignment, and reliability. Ideal for enterprise-grade workflows requiring 
trustworthy AI outputs.

tool_cognee.description:
Persistent semantic memory backed by a Cognee server, exposed as three agent tools. 
Remember plain text, recall memory results while requesting references, and check background processing. The knowledge graph captures semantic relationships; it is not an AST, import graph, or call graph.

allow_dataset_override.description: Allow agents to select a dataset per call. Leave off when several agents should share one operator-controlled memory scope.
allow_dataset_override.title: Allow dataset override

api_key.description: Cognee API key sent as the X-Api-Key header. Falls back to COGNEE_API_KEY. Self-hosted servers with access control disabled can leave this blank.
api_key.title: API Key

base_url.description: Base URL of the Cognee server. Self-hosted Cognee defaults to http://localhost:8000. For Cognee Cloud, use the instance URL from platform.cognee.ai.
base_url.title: Server URL

dataset.description: Default Cognee dataset used by all agent tools. Tool calls stay in this operator-controlled scope unless per-call overrides are enabled.
dataset.title: Dataset

request_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for one Cognee request.
request_timeout.title: Request timeout (s)

search_type.description: How recall retrieves memory. Graph completion decomposition is the semantic default; the agent can override it per call.
search_type.title: Default recall strategy

top_k.description: Maximum number of results recall retrieves per query.
top_k.title: Recall results (top_k)

tool_cognee.title: Cognee

db_hydradb.description:
A database/tool node for HydraDB, a managed graph + memory store. 
Exposes agent-callable tools to store text as memories (with automatic knowledge-graph 
extraction) and recall graph-enriched context by natural-language query. Retrieval is 
HydraDB's native server-side search - no embeddings or query language required.

api_key.description: HydraDB API key. Falls back to the HYDRA_DB_API_KEY environment variable if left blank.
api_key.title: API Key

collection.description: Collection scope within the database (per-user/workspace partition for memories).
collection.title: Collection

database.description: HydraDB database - the space that stores your context. Create one in the HydraDB dashboard.
database.title: Database

max_results.description: Default maximum number of results returned by recall_memory.
max_results.title: Max results

db_hydradb.title: HydraDB

db_hotdata.description:
Creates one ephemeral Hotdata database for each pipeline run.
Lets agents inspect its live schema and execute read-only SQL before the database is destroyed at teardown.

llm.description: LLM used to generate SQL from natural language

allow_destructive_load.description: Permit load_data to use replace, update or delete modes, which overwrite or remove existing rows. Off by default: load_data is append/upsert only, so an agent cannot destroy data another pipeline step loaded.
allow_destructive_load.title: Allow destructive loads

allow_execute.description: Permit trusted callers to submit raw read-only SQL.
allow_execute.title: Allow direct query execution

api_url.description: Hotdata API base URL. Leave empty for https://api.hotdata.dev.
api_url.title: API URL

apikey.description: Hotdata API key.
apikey.title: API Key

async_after_ms.description: Wait this long before a query continues as an asynchronous job.
async_after_ms.title: Run asynchronously after (milliseconds)

db_description.description: Schema and domain hints for natural-language SQL generation.
db_description.title: Database description

job_timeout_secs.description: Maximum time to wait for an asynchronous query.
job_timeout_secs.title: Job timeout (seconds)

max_execute_rows.description: Maximum rows returned by raw SQL execution.
max_execute_rows.title: Maximum execute rows

table.description: Table that rows arriving on the answers lane are loaded into. Created on first use.
table.title: Table

ttl.description: Crash-safety expiry for the ephemeral database.
ttl.title: Database lifetime

db_hotdata.title: Hotdata

response_json.description:
A component that returns structured JSON data back to the requesting client. It handles 
the response phase of the HTTP request-response cycle by returning the results as a JSON 
object. This component ensures that data is transmitted efficiently and clearly to 
the client, providing a standardized format for the response.
response_json.title: Return JSON

chat.description:
A user interface component that provides a web-based chat experience. It 
creates its own HTTP endpoint, configured by host and port, to serve a simple 
chat UI. Users can interact with the interface to submit questions, which 
are routed through the attached pipeline for processing. Designed for easy 
integration, it enables the addition of conversational capabilities to any 
pipeline workflow.
chat.title: Chat
